name: Environmental Initiatives Fund
summary: Grants funded by Entergy shareholders for projects that reduce emissions, protect natural resources and restore wetlands, forests and habitat, in Entergy's four-state service area.

eligibility.rule: Not a political, lobbying, fraternal, merchant, chamber, 501(c)(4) or 501(c)(6) organization

status.quote: Applications for the Entergy's Environmental Initiatives Fund's 2026 grants are being accepted until May 31, 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications for the Entergy's Environmental Initiatives Fund's 2026 grants are being accepted until May 31, 2026.

access.quote: You can find the request for proposals for funding on the Environmental Initiatives Fund's website.

window.quote: Applications for the Entergy's Environmental Initiatives Fund's 2026 grants are being accepted until May 31, 2026.

geography.quote: The fund recently awarded $1 million in funds from Entergy shareholders to local environmental partners in Entergy's four-state service area.

effort.quote: Applications must be received no later than midnight, Central Time, on May 31, 2026.

eligibility.quote: Funding will not be provided for political organizations or organizations designed primarily to lobby, fraternal organizations, merchant associations, chamber memberships or programs, or 501(c)(4) or (6) organizations.

after_award.quote: will be required to submit semi-annual reports that include financial data detailing how funds were used, the overall status of the project, and the quantifiable environmental benefits of the Project.
